# PH's AIxArchviz LTX2.5 Series: CAMCONTROLLED IMAGE 2 VIDEO
*(cc-by-sa 4.0)*

*A camera-controlled workflow that lets you direct image 2 video generation with a driving animation to steer your camera movement.*

Showcase: [Youtube Video Walkthrough](https://youtu.be/6aXJqRhjXo0)
___
## Support, feedback, suggestions and improvements highly appreciated ❤️
- comfycloud: [ComfyCloud](https://cloud.comfy.org/?via=ph01) (affiliate link, i may earn a commission)
- Web: [paulhansen.de](https://www.paulhansen.de)
- Instagram: [paulhansen.design](https://www.instagram.com/paulhansen.design/)
- LinkedIn: [Paul Hansen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ph3d)
- Discord: [PH's AIxArchviz Discord](https://discord.gg/3UW5ZaWpWq)
- Ko-Fi: [ko-fi/paulhansen](https://www.ko-fi.com/paulhansen)

___
## HOW TO USE THIS WORKFLOW
Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load any image in the LOAD IMAGE node as a starting frame for your video generation, load any video as a reference for the camera animation in the LOAD VIDEO node and hit RUN. Note that aspect ratio will be adopted from the LOAD IMAGE input, depending on your resolution there might be some cropping to match best working video settings (resolutions should be divisible by 32).
___
### Custom Nodes (all available on comfycloud):

- [ComfyUI-KJNodes by Kijai](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite by Kosinkadink](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

*For installation, use the ComfyUI-Manager or find the terminal commands in the respective repository, e.g. `git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes` executed in `<YOUR_PATH_TO_COMFYUI>/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/`*

### Model Downloads for Local Inference

**diffusion_models**
- [ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) *(gated)*

**text_encoders**
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) *(gated)*

**loras**
- [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors)
- [LTX2.3-22B_IC-LoRA-Cameraman_v1_10500.safetensors by Cseti](https://huggingface.co/Cseti/LTX2.3-22B_IC-LoRA-Cameraman_v1/resolve/main/LTX2.3-22B_IC-LoRA-Cameraman_v1_10500.safetensors)

**vae**
- [ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) *(gated)*
- [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) *(gated)*

**latent_upscale_models**
- [ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors) *(gated)*

**frame_interpolation**
- [film_net_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/frame_interpolation/resolve/main/frame_interpolation/film_net_fp16.safetensors)

*Models marked **gated** require you to log in and accept the license on the respective huggingface repository before downloading.*

Model Storage Location
```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
     ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
     │    └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
     ├── 📂 text_encoders/
     │    └── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
     ├── 📂 loras/
     │    ├── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-384.safetensors
     │    └── LTX2.3-22B_IC-LoRA-Cameraman_v1_10500.safetensors
     ├── 📂 vae/
     │    ├── ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
     │    └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
     ├── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
     │    └── ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors
     └── 📂 frame_interpolation/
          └── film_net_fp16.safetensors
```
